name: ntfy
description: Notifications from an ntfy topic, and how many came in
complete-description:
Listens to an ntfy topic the whole time OmniCore is running — a lightweight way to push alerts to a display from scripts, other services, or anything that can make an HTTP request. Each new message pops up as a notification on any OmniView showing the face, staying up longer the higher its ntfy priority.

The tile answers one question at a glance: did anything happen? It shows how many announcements came in the window you pick (the last 24 hours by default), how long ago the latest one came, and its priority. The details stay on your phone. Messages fetched when connecting only count toward the tile; only messages that arrive while it's running raise a notification. Several ntfy tiles on the same server share one connection between them. Works with ntfy.sh or your own server, HTTP or HTTPS.
